caps: classic flights, up to 2.5 Hohmann times
meta.ephemeris: JPL DE440 for planets (Horizons DE441 barycentres after 2149); daily JPL Horizons states for small bodies
meta.method: Cheapest of the daily transfer alternatives (engine/daily.py) among flights up to 30 years: Lambert transfers (pykep) with every number of revolutions around the Sun the flight time allows. Departure and arrival burns from the stated parking orbits via the Oberth relation sqrt(vinf^2 + 2mu/r) - sqrt(mu/r); small bodies use rendezvous vinf. Impulsive burns, no gravity assists, no low-thrust.
